title: Mexico City Notaries, eighteenth century
descriptions: This dataset contains an inventory of notaries active in Mexico City, New Spain in the eighteenth century. The language used is Spanish. The information originates from two guides at the Archivo General de Notarías de la Ciudad de México, specifically its historical documents.
